programme.sub-title: Is Trump going to bomb the bond market?
programme.desc: The US government owes the rest of the world trillions of dollars, and somehow that's the thing holding the global economy together - your mortgage, your super, the price of your groceries are all tied in some way to US debt.

programme.title: ABC News
programme.desc: Melissa Mackay presents the latest from ABC News on the weekend bringing you today's top stories and coverage of events as they unfold. Plus original reporting, analysis and updated news, sport, weather and information.

programme.title: Planet America: Fireside Chat
programme.desc: Did Trump and Musk intentionally slowdown the satellite service used by Ukraine's military? Also, the "despicable" attack ad drawing a bipartisan backlash in Ohio, and the fake polling firm that duped the media.

programme.title: ABC News
programme.desc: Melissa Mackay presents the latest from ABC News on the weekend bringing you today's top stories and coverage of events as they unfold. Plus original reporting, analysis and updated news, sport, weather and information.

programme.title: BTN
programme.desc: We take a look at Australia's immigration debate, meet a teenager helping kids to cope with bullying, and find out which creepy crawlies are in the running for Insect of the Year. Presented by Amelia Moseley.

programme.title: Heywire
programme.desc: Marley and her mum have logged over 180 volunteer hours at Sovereign Hill, stepping into 1850s costumes as a mother-daughter duo.

programme.title: ABC News
programme.desc: Melissa Mackay presents the latest from ABC News on the weekend bringing you today's top stories and coverage of events as they unfold. Plus original reporting, analysis and updated news, sport, weather and information.

programme.title: Asia News Week
programme.desc: Join Yvonne Yong for the latest news from Asia. This week: Indonesians protest over a haze crisis, a rocket launched in Japan to one of Mars' moons, and Indian voters speak out after a mass electoral roll purge.

programme.title: ABC Evening News
programme.desc: For the latest news as it happens ABC News is the home of breaking news, compelling stories and original reporting. Meredith Sheehan presents the day's top stories and updated news from across Australia and around the globe.

programme.title: Australian Story
programme.desc: It was one of Australia's deadliest bus crashes, killing 10 and injuring 25. Three years on, survivors speak for the first time about the horror, their recovery and the need for systemic change.

programme.title: ABC National News
programme.desc: There's never been a more important time for transparency and trust. ABC News brings you today's top stories and latest news, with more reporters to tell you what's going on and why it matters. Presented by Meredith Sheehan.

programme.title: Back Roads
programme.desc: Lisa Millar continues her exploration of Shark Bay, a World Heritage listed wilderness on the westernmost point of Western Australia. It's a vivid contrast of turquoise waters and red desert cliffs.

programme.title: ABC News Tonight
programme.desc: The latest headlines and the day's top stories from ABC News. Presented by Meredith Sheehan.

programme.title: Four Corners
